title: Release Engineering Weekly Notes - 2026-03-24
content:
Attendees: Jordan Kim (notes), Priya Shah, Marcus Lee, Sofia Martinez, Evan Park, Olivia Chen (SRE), Randy Ortiz (platform eng)

Agenda:
- Quick sync on active release trains and upcoming deploy windows
- Hotfix status and rollback readiness
- Changelog highlights for this week
- Canary metrics review and next steps
- Blockers / action items

1) Current release trains
- 2026.03.2 (minor): Target deploy Thu 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC. Contains batching improvements and a config flag for continuous batching threshold.
  - Owner: Priya
  - PRs grouped: infra PR #987 (autoscaler tune), serving PRs: svc-batcher#452, svc-router#220
  - Risks: autoscaler change might cause transient pod churn during scale-down; canary to ramp slowly.
  - Plan: deploy to staging Mon 03-24, run k6 load tests Tue, smoke on staging Wed, prod rollout Thu 02:00 UTC canary at 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if healthy.

- 2026.03.3 (feature): Rolling featureset across dedicated pools; includes quantization profile selection feature.
  - Owner: Marcus
  - Target window: Tue 2026-03-31 06:00 UTC (post-commit to avoid traffic peaks)
  - Note: need signoff from applied-ml on quantization perf. Pending evals RE-1234.

2) Hotfixes
- HOTFIX-3421: Observed increased 500s in routing service for specific header combos. Hotfix deployed to prod Fri 03-20 as 2026.03.1-hotfix.
  - Root cause: null pointer in header parsing when legacy client tag present. Fix applied in svc-router#225.
  - Status: Stabilized, error rate back to baseline. Keeping hotfix branch open for one more week to allow rollback if regressions show.
  - Action: Sofia to add additional unit/integration tests and add a Canary test that simulates legacy headers (due 2026-03-26).

3) Canary metrics review (last 48h)
- Latency p95 for canary of autoscaler changes: +6ms (baseline 98ms -> 104ms); CPU consumption down ~8% during steady-state traffic.
- Errors: no statistically significant change after hotfix.
- Cost: estimated token-cost per request unchanged.
- Verdict: small latency bump acceptable given CPU reduction; continue canary as planned.

4) Changelog highlights (for product release notes)
- Improvement: reduced autoscaler oscillation under bursty traffic (infra PR #987).
- New: continuous-batching threshold config (opt-in) for servicing memory-sensitive workloads.
- Fix: header parsing null-pointer fixed (HOTFIX-3421).
- Known issues: quantization toggles may cause small perf variance on older GPU types; see RE-1234.
- Communication: Jordan to draft short release note and share in #product-updates and #customer-notifications by Wed EOD.

5) Rollback and incident readiness
- Rollback plan for 2026.03.2: automated rollback job pre-built in release pipeline. If canary error rate >1% for 5m or latency p95 increases >25% for 10m, pipeline will pause and ops will be paged.
- On-call: Olivia (SRE) and Randy (platform eng) are primary during rollout window.

6) Blockers / open questions
- Applied-ML signoff on quantization perf (RE-1234) still pending — Marcus to sync with Priya and allocate dedicated eval slots.
- Autoscaler tuning: need a follow-up RFC for long-term autoscaler behavior under multi-tenant noise. Priya to draft RFC by 2026-04-02.
- Changelog formatting: PMs want shorter bullets for external release notes; Jordan to produce two versions (internal detailed + external short).

7) Action items (owners and dates)
- Sofia: add header legacy-tests + integration test for HOTFIX-3421 by 2026-03-26.
- Priya: run staging k6 load tests and share results Tue 2026-03-25.
- Marcus: finalize applied-ml quantization evals and get signoff by 2026-03-30 (RE-1234).
- Jordan: draft release notes (internal + external) and post to #product-updates by 2026-03-25.
- Randy/Olivia: confirm on-call schedule and runbook review by 2026-03-24 (today) — completed during meeting.

8) Quick retrospective notes
- Good: faster hotfix turnaround this sprint, CI gating prevented an infra regression from reaching prod.
- Improve: more pre-release integration tests for header-edge cases; consider adding synthetic traffic generator for legacy client types to our regression suite.

9) Misc / FYI
- Release train calendar: next blackout window for database patching is 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-07; avoid heavy infra changes near that date.
- PM asks: can we include a short note in internal changelog about cost impact of batching changes? Priya to provide cost delta after tests.

Next meeting: 2026-03-31 same time.

Notes (raw):
- TODO: follow up on infra PR #987 comments about scale-down grace period.
- Question for SRE: do we want to add synthetic canary traffic that exercises KV cache warm path? (Olivia to evaluate)
- Meeting tone: mostly operational; keep next meeting focused on post-deploy telemetry and customer-facing notes.
